runtime_proof.measurement_basis: Read-only SQL against the production Supabase project (zfzdnfwdarxucxtaojxm) via MCP execute_sql, plus offline execution of the changed code paths and seven mutations. No production write, no DDL, no provider call.

queries.name: the source table this change moves TO is populated
queries.method: SELECT count(*), min(snapshot_at), max(snapshot_at), count(DISTINCT provider_key) FROM provider_offer_history
queries.result: 14,456,685 rows spanning 2026-05-11 to 2026-06-30; exactly one distinct provider_key, 'sgo'.
queries.significance: Establishes that the new source carries the live data the marking pass needs.

queries.name: the source table this change moves FROM is vacuous for the live window
queries.method: SELECT count(*), min(snapshot_at), max(snapshot_at), count(DISTINCT provider_event_id) FROM provider_offer_history_compact
queries.result: 3,139 rows spanning 2026-04-24 to 2026-04-26, one distinct event. No overlap with the history range at all.
queries.significance: The defect is not a performance nuance. The old source could not have marked a single live closing line.

queries.name: a concrete recent event has eligible rows in history and none in compact
queries.method: Eligible-row count for one recent provider_event_id in each table, using the same snapshot_at < commence_time predicate the code applies
queries.result: 165,414 eligible unmarked rows in provider_offer_history; 0 in provider_offer_history_compact.
queries.significance: Names the vacuity concretely on real production data rather than in the abstract.

queries.name: the bounded query is partition-pruned rather than a full scan
queries.method: EXPLAIN (ANALYZE, BUFFERS) on the exact bounded query the code issues, limit 5000
queries.result: Append over 3 pruned child partitions, Index Scan Backward on (provider_event_id, snapshot_at), 81.943 ms.
queries.significance: Refutes the seq-scan premise that motivated the compact table, and shows the new source is safe to point at.

queries.name: every partition carries the index the plan depends on
queries.method: Index inventory across all child partitions of provider_offer_history
queries.result: All 60 child partitions carry the (provider_event_id, snapshot_at) index.
queries.significance: The pruned plan is not an artifact of the one partition sampled; it holds across the table.

queries.name: the ordered selection is reproducible
queries.method: SHA-256 over the ordered result of the bounded selection
queries.significance: Gives the measurement an identity a later reviewer can re-derive.
